description: Exclusive to Projectors with an open emotional centre and defined G centre. Talk things through to find clarity.
decision_style: Clarity comes through speaking your truth out loud to a trusted listener. Not seeking their advice — just being heard. Your own voice reveals what you actually want.
time_to_decide: After speaking through the decision with someone you trust. Listen to yourself, not to them.
career_application: Cultivate a small circle of trusted listeners for major career decisions. Talk through options out loud. Pay attention to what comes out of your mouth rather than what's in your head.
common_mistake: Asking for opinions and following advice rather than listening to your own voice emerging in the conversation.
